explication: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent for natural-language finance research, strategy analysis, and backtesting. A user can interact through the CLI or API; the agent runtime coordinates tools and market-data access, with research and backtest modules producing analysis and run results. The repository also includes factor research, messaging-channel integrations, and shadow-account persistence. The tree and excerpts identify these major components, but do not establish every route-to-tool call, so uncertain connections are omitted.
